from collections import deque

def bfs_depth_n(graph, start, target_depth):
    # Returns nodes at exactly target_depth (not including start node at depth 0)
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])
    depth_nodes = defaultdict(set)
    
    while queue:
        node, depth = queue.popleft()
        
        if depth == target_depth:
            depth_nodes[depth].add(node)
            continue  # Don't explore further from target depth
        
        if depth < target_depth:
            for neighbor in graph.get(node, []):
                if neighbor not in visited:
                    visited.add(neighbor)
                    queue.append((neighbor, depth + 1))
                    depth_nodes[depth + 1].add(neighbor)
    
    return depth_nodes[target_depth]

# Run BFS

def bfs_trace(graph, start, max_depth):
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])
    levels = defaultdict(set)
    levels[0].add(start)
    
    while queue:
        node, depth = queue.popleft()
        if depth >= max_depth:

        for neighbor in graph.get(node, []):
            if neighbor not in visited:
                visited.add(neighbor)
                queue.append((neighbor, depth + 1))
                levels[depth + 1].add(neighbor)
    
    return levels

from collections import deque

def bfs_depth_n(graph, start, target_depth):
    # Returns nodes at exactly target_depth (not including start node at depth 0)
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])
    depth_nodes = defaultdict(set)
    
    while queue:
        node, depth = queue.popleft()
        
        if depth == target_depth:
            depth_nodes[depth].add(node)
            continue  # Don't explore further from target depth
        
        if depth < target_depth:
            for neighbor in graph.get(node, []):
                if neighbor not in visited:
                    visited.add(neighbor)
                    queue.append((neighbor, depth + 1))
                    depth_nodes[depth + 1].add(neighbor)
    
    return depth_nodes[target_depth]

    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])

    while queue:

        if depth >= max_depth:

            if neighbor not in visited:
                visited.add(neighbor)
                queue.append((neighbor, depth + 1))
                levels[depth + 1].add(neighbor)

def bfs_depth_n(graph, start, target_depth):
    # Returns nodes at exactly target_depth (not including start node at depth 0)
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])
    depth_nodes = defaultdict(set)

from collections import deque

def bfs_depth_n(graph, start, target_depth):
    # Returns nodes at exactly target_depth (not including start node at depth 0)
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])
    depth_nodes = defaultdict(set)
    
    while queue:
        node, depth = queue.popleft()
        
        if depth == target_depth:
            depth_nodes[depth].add(node)
            continue  # Don't explore further from target depth
        
        if depth < target_depth:
            for neighbor in graph.get(node, []):
                if neighbor not in visited:
                    visited.add(neighbor)
                    queue.append((neighbor, depth + 1))
                    depth_nodes[depth + 1].add(neighbor)
    
    return depth_nodes[target_depth]

# Run BFS

def bfs_trace(graph, start, max_depth):
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])
    levels = defaultdict(set)
    levels[0].add(start)
    
    while queue:
        node, depth = queue.popleft()
        if depth >= max_depth:
            continue
        for neighbor in graph.get(node, []):
            if neighbor not in visited:
                visited.add(neighbor)
                queue.append((neighbor, depth + 1))
                levels[depth + 1].add(neighbor)
    
    return levels

def bfs_depth_n(graph, start, target_depth):
    # Returns nodes at exactly target_depth (not including start node at depth 0)
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])
    depth_nodes = defaultdict(set)
    
    while queue:
        node, depth = queue.popleft()
        
        if depth == target_depth:
            depth_nodes[depth].add(node)
            continue  # Don't explore further from target depth

            for neighbor in graph.get(node, []):
                if neighbor not in visited:
                    visited.add(neighbor)
                    queue.append((neighbor, depth + 1))
                    depth_nodes[depth + 1].add(neighbor)

def bfs_depth_n(graph, start, target_depth):
    # Returns nodes at exactly target_depth (not including start node at depth 0)
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])
    depth_nodes = defaultdict(set)
    
    while queue:

            depth_nodes[depth].add(node)
            continue  # Don't explore further from target depth
        
        if depth < target_depth:
            for neighbor in graph.get(node, []):
                if neighbor not in visited:
                    visited.add(neighbor)
                    queue.append((neighbor, depth + 1))

def bfs_depth_n(graph, start, target_depth):
    # Returns nodes at exactly target_depth (not including start node at depth 0)
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])
    depth_nodes = defaultdict(set)
    
    while queue:

        if depth == target_depth:
            depth_nodes[depth].add(node)
            continue  # Don't explore further from target depth
        
        if depth < target_depth:
            for neighbor in graph.get(node, []):
                if neighbor not in visited:
                    visited.add(neighbor)
                    queue.append((neighbor, depth + 1))
                    depth_nodes[depth + 1].add(neighbor)

from collections import deque

def bfs_depth_n(graph, start, target_depth):
    # Returns nodes at exactly target_depth (not including start node at depth 0)
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])
    depth_nodes = defaultdict(set)
    
    while queue:
        node, depth = queue.popleft()
        
        if depth == target_depth:
            depth_nodes[depth].add(node)
            continue  # Don't explore further from target depth
        
        if depth < target_depth:
            for neighbor in graph.get(node, []):
                if neighbor not in visited:
                    visited.add(neighbor)
                    queue.append((neighbor, depth + 1))
                    depth_nodes[depth + 1].add(neighbor)
